facts.business: Innovassynth Technologies (India) Limited is a research-driven Contract Research Development and Manufacturing Organisation (CRDMO) and specialty chemicals company providing integrated chemistry-led research, process development, scale-up and manufacturing capabilities to customers across life sciences and industrial markets.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company witnessed a notable improvement in business momentum during the latter part of FY26. Customer engagement strengthened, order inflows increased and demand for key Life science building blocks improved, resulting in a healthy level of open purchase orders and improved visibility entering FY27.
guidance_or_targets.value: Healthy level of open purchase orders

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on accounting for Scheme of Merger by Absorption of associate Innovassynth Technologies (India) Limited with the Company approved by NCLT vide order dated November 14, 2025; comparative financial information restated from Appointed Date. Opinion not modified in respect of this matter.

key_risks: Industry-wide inventory adjustments and demand moderation across segments of the Life science supply chain
Customer ordering patterns and capacity utilisation impacted during first half of FY26
Integration and consolidation of acquired business post-merger
Geopolitical uncertainties affecting global business environment
facts.related_party_note: Loan from directors outstanding as at March 31, 2026: Rs 1,226.63 Lakhs (March 31, 2025: Rs 1,112.81 Lakhs) at 7.50% p.a., repayable on demand.
